messages:
maria: Hey team — heads-up: there's a community release called elysium-7b-v2 that just landed. Want to intake and decide a quantization + calibration plan. Goals: match fp16 quality within 1-2% on our llm-eval suite, target ~3x token-cost reduction vs fp16, and keep 95th p99 latency within Dedicated A10 profile for 512-token generations. Thoughts?
vikram: +1. Can you drop the eval corpus and a few perf targets? need baseline fp16 metrics (latency, throughput, ppl/accuracy) before we pick a precision.
olivia: pinged the bench bucket: I'll run fp16 baseline on a small slice today. also: any unusual tokenizer changes from upstream? that affects kv cache behavior.
maria: tokenizer looks identical, just some ADAPTER weights added. baseline targets: ppl on lm-100k subset, instruction-combo eval (our 12 prompts), and rerank micro-bench. latency target: median <80ms, p99 <240ms (single request, 1xA10). budget note: prefer int8 if quality holds, but open to fp8 hybrid if it buys latency/cost.
zach: For calibration, recommend two-pass approach: 1) quick histogram/activation sweep with 2k sequences to find outlier layers, 2) per-layer percentile clipping + per-channel scale (if int8). We'll need per-layer activation stats export.
calib-bot: Automated smoke run template:
```
calib-run --model elysium-7b-v2 --mode quick-sweep --samples 2048 --batch 8 --out /tmp/elysium_sweep.json
calib-apply --model elysium-7b-v2 --strategy per-layer-percentile --percentile 99.995 --out /calib/elysium_calib.json
```
calib-bot: quants tested in quick-sweep: int8-symmetric, int8-affine, fp8-e4m3 and hybrid int8+fp8. Outputs: per-layer overflow rates and est quality delta vs fp16.
vikram: Good. For gguf packaging: ensure we preserve tokenizer.json and model metadata, and add a calibration manifest so runtime can pick fallback. Also test a gguf-hybrid (kv cache in fp16, matmuls int8) path.
olivia: I'll queue the baseline and the calib quick-sweep, posting results here. Expect first pass by EOD PST. If we see >1.5% metric regression for int8, we try fp8 with reduced clipping.
maria: If int8 passes, we want a smoke production run on Dedicated with batching 4 and streaming disabled to validate latency. Who can own the Dedicated smoke?
zach: I can set up the dedicated job. I'll also add a tracing hook to capture KV cache hit rates and per-token latency.
vikram: Also add a quality regression eval tied to the PR so any future model tweaks alert. small checklist: [ ] baseline fp16 metrics, [ ] quick-sweep calib, [ ] per-layer histogram, [ ] gguf packaging + manifest, [ ] dedicated smoke run, [ ] regression alerts setup.
olivia: starting baseline now. will post interim numbers.
maria: thanks. tagging @zach for dedicated deploy once olivia posts baselines. :thumbsup:
zach: noted.
calib-bot: queued job 1767777801 for quick-sweep. will post results: /jobs/1767777801/logs when done.
vikram: if quick-sweep shows a few hot layers with >0.1% overflow, try per-channel symmetric instead of affine and rerun. small changes often fix head-saturation issues.
maria: ok plan looks actionable. We'll reconvene after quick-sweep. If anyone spots a tokenizer mismatch or different checkpoint varnames, shout here immediately.
olivia: first fp16 pass done: median latency 76ms, p99 210ms, ppl 12.4 on lm-100k subset. uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-elysium/baselines/1767777777
maria: nice. thanks olivia. zach once calib output lands please run the Dedicated smoke and post the traces.
zach: will do.
calib-bot: quick-sweep complete. summary: int8-affine shows avg est quality delta +2.1% (worse) vs fp16, int8-symmetric +1.6%, fp8-e4m3 +0.7%. hot layers: 18, 21 show high outliers. full artifact: s3://redwood-elysium/calib/1767777777/summary.json
vikram: fp8 looks promising. let's try hybrid: int8 for lower layers, fp8 for layers with high dynamic range (18,21). also run a calibration with percentile 99.999 for those layers.
olivia: queuing hybrid run now. will kick off a 10k-sample calibration for final pass.
maria: perfect. tagging this thread for the intake record. we'll capture final artifacts and decide precision for canary rollout after the 10k run. thanks all.
